description: FULL BODY: A Malaysian male police officer in his late 30s. He is wearing a crisp, formal Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM) uniform including a navy blue short-sleeved shirt with official insignia, matching trousers, a black leather belt, and polished black boots. He has a neat, short haircut and a clean-shaven face.

FULL BODY: A middle-aged Malaysian man in his late 40s. He is dressed in a casual professional attire consisting of a light blue button-up shirt with sleeves rolled up to the elbows, dark charcoal grey slacks, and brown leather loafers. He has short black hair with slight graying at the temples.

FULL BODY: A featureless, anonymous humanoid silhouette wearing a ghostly, translucent business suit. The figure is composed of dark, flowing digital data particles with glowing red eyes. The overall appearance is a robotic, AI-generated entity representing a false identity.

FULL BODY: A sleek, mechanical humanoid robot with a metallic silver surface and glowing blue circuitry lines running across its limbs. Instead of a face, it has a flat digital screen displaying a spinning 'loading' icon. Its form is slim and clinical, symbolizing an automated digital program.
